title: The Power of Hedging
text:
Many readers assume that a writer who uses the phrase 'it seems' is being weak. In fact, hedging language can signal honesty. When a critic writes that a film is 'arguably the best of the year', the qualifier shows that the opinion is open to debate. Such words invite the reader to think rather than simply accept.

However, hedges can also be used to avoid responsibility. A politician who says 'mistakes may have been made' does not admit any specific error. Listeners should therefore ask whether a qualifier reflects genuine uncertainty or is merely a way to escape criticism.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what does the phrase 'arguably the best of the year' show?
options: that the opinion is open to debate
that the film is certainly excellent
that the film was released late

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what does the example of the politician show?
options: the politician avoided naming a specific error
the politician was asked to resign
the listeners were confused by the speech

questions.text: What can be inferred about the writer's view of hedging?
options: Hedging is always a sign of weakness
Hedging can be useful but can also be misused
Hedging should never be used in criticism
Hedging appears only in political speeches

questions.text: Why does the writer suggest that readers should question qualifiers?
options: to find grammar errors in the text
to separate real uncertainty from evasion
to avoid thinking critically about the speech
to decide which critic is correct

vocabulary.definition: using cautious language to avoid stating something too strongly
a word or phrase that limits or softens a statement
a state of not being sure about something

paragraph_translations: Багато читачів вважають, що письменник, який використовує фразу 'it seems', виглядає слабким. Насправді пом'якшені висловлювання можуть свідчити про чесність. Коли критик пише, що фільм є 'arguably the best of the year', застереження показує, що думка може бути предметом дискусії. Такі слова спонукають читача думати, а не просто приймати все на віру.

Однак пом'якшення можна використовувати і для уникнення відповідальності. Політик, який каже 'mistakes may have been made', не визнає жодної конкретної помилки. Тому слухачам варто запитати себе, чи відображає застереження справжню невизначеність, чи це лише спосіб уникнути критики.
